senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; פָּרַשׁ)secretion, excrements (found in the entrails).
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 20a:8">Pes. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>נמצאת בפ׳</he> if the liquid is found in the excrements of the slaughtered animal.

<cite ref="Pesachim 20a:8">Ib.</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>וליהדר פ׳ וכ׳</he> why should not the excrements again make the flesh unclean? <cite ref="Pesachim 20a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ עבה</he> thick, substantial excrements, <he>פ׳ רכה</he> soft, viscid secretions.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 34b:15">Ab. Zar. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>פִּרְשׁוֹ מותרת</he> its discharge may be used. Y. ib. II, 41ᶜ bot. <he>פִּירְשָׁהּ גיפה הוא</he> an animal’s discharge is part of its body; a. e.
